name: boxel-cli
description: Skills for working with Boxel realms via @cardstack/boxel-cli. Requires @cardstack/boxel-cli >= 0.0.1 installed on PATH (npm install -g @cardstack/boxel-cli).

interface.shortDescription: Author and sync Boxel cards, realms, and workspaces
interface.longDescription: Create and edit Boxel cards, fields, and templates, then sync them between local disk and a Boxel realm — with skills covering card authoring, theming, catalog listings, federated search, and realm indexing diagnostics.
defaultPrompt: Create a Boxel card for the data I describe
Pull my Boxel workspace down so I can edit it locally
